crossRefs.note: Saul knew David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”
How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
translations.bsb: When David had finished saying these things, Saul called back, “Is that your voice, David my son?” Then Saul wept aloud
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
